ötünç soramak: conjugation

ötünç soramak: to apologize. Below, every verb form the course teaches from A1 to B1, built on ötünç soramak, with the six persons in the positive, the negative and the question.

Infinitiveötünç soramak
Stemötünç sora-
Presentötünç soraýar
Pastötünç sorady
Futureötünç sorajak
General presentötünç sorar · ötünç soramaz
Converbötünç sorap
Imperativeötünç sora · ötünç soraň

Men ondan ötünç soradym.

I apologized to him.

  • Only soramak changes; ötünç stays as it is: ötünç sorady, ötünç soraýar.
  • The stem ends in a vowel, so the general present is just -r: ötünç sorar, ötünç soraryn.
  • The person you apologize to takes -dan: senden ötünç soraýaryn. The everyday sorry is bagyşlaň.

Practice ötünç soramak with the flashcards, or see every ending on one page in the grammar cheat sheet.

ötünç soramak is first taught in B1 · Unit 2: Used to, was going to, should have, and it's in the flashcard deck. Daily Turkmen is a free course from A1 to B1, with short lessons and instant feedback. No account needed.

About these tables

Endings are written as in the course: A stands for a or e (ä in some endings, written Ä), Y for y or i (u or ü after a rounded vowel, as the rounding rule says), and letters in brackets are used only after a consonant, like the Y of -(Y)p, or only after a vowel. The question ending -mY is written onto the word it asks about. Where a cell gives two forms, the course teaches the first and accepts the others.

The forms are built by Daily Turkmen's own conjugation engine, which is tested against more than 2,000 forms typed by hand and checked against the course's exercises and flashcards.
